Healthy Banana Bread for Toddlers 🍌✨ ✅This easy, healthy banana bread recipe swaps chocolate chips for raisins, making it naturally sweet, full of fiber, protein, and toddler-approved! Perfect for healthy snacks for kids, toddler breakfast, or easy homemade treats. 💛 Ingredients: (180c°/ 30-40 min) 2 ripe bananas 🍌 2 eggs 🥚 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1/4 tsp cinnamon 1/2 cup Greek yogurt (120g) 1 cup oat flour (100g) 1/4 cup chopped walnuts (30g) 1/2 tbsp baking powder ( 5g) 1/2 cup rolled oats (50g) 1/4 cup raisins ( 40g) , soaked in hot water for 10 minutes and chopped ✨ Perfect for busy moms who want healthy snacks for toddlers! #toddlersnacks  #kidfriendlysnacks #toddlerapproved #nosugaradded
